caption:
Global Metadata: A soulful, evocative Middle Eastern instrumental piece, 84 BPM, with an Arabic maqam flavor. Centered on the oud (pear-shaped plucked lute) with its warm resonant tone and ornate melodic lines, accompanied by a darbuka (goblet drum), a riq (tambourine) and a deep oud bass. The oud opens with a contemplative improvised-sounding melody, the darbuka and riq add a rhythmic pulse, the oud plays a flowing ornate passage, then a livelier dance rhythm takes over before settling to a gentle contemplative ending. Production profile: close, warm recording of traditional Arabic instruments, resonant oud tone, crisp darbuka, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: No vocals at all. Purely instrumental. Do not add any singing, humming, or voice.

Arrangement: Intro, the oud alone plays a contemplative ornate melody. Section one, the darbuka and riq add a rhythmic pulse, the oud continues. Section two, the oud plays a flowing ornate passage over the percussion. Section three, a livelier dance rhythm takes over, the oud ornaments freely. Outro, settles to a gentle contemplative ending and a soft fade.
